blocks.corrected_text: J. J. Thomson, in 1898, proposed that an atom possesses a spherical shape (radius approximately 10⁻¹⁰ m) in which the positive charge is uniformly distributed. The electrons are embedded into it in such a manner as to give the most stable electrostatic arrangement (Fig. 2.4).
